notes: Monster races (Docs/Races.md), authored by Tools/AuthorRaces.py - edit the script, not this file. Every unit is an NPC archetype (NPCArchetypes.json schema) plus race data; 'extends' units keep their NPCArchetypes.json definition and add pool abilities. slot: line|bruiser|tank|caster|ranged|special (+ bosses warlord|colossus). fallback names the existing Tripo body drawn (reskinned with the race palette) until Content/Data/RaceMeshes.tripo.json provides real art. skillPool = every non-basic ability; each match draws poolDraw of them per unit type (seeded) and waves unlock them (Waves.json skillProgression). Ability riders: root/silence/slow seconds, knockback cm; kinds pull and summon are race additions. buff = BuffVisuals.json id, cue = AudioCues.json id.

abilities.description: Its prism flares: for 6s nearby champions deal 35% less damage to anything but the Bulwark.

abilities.name: Hardlight Shell
abilities.description: Below 50% health it closes a shell of hard light: 50% less damage for 6s.

abilities.name: Link Shield
abilities.description: Links a shield to the most injured ally, taking 40% of its damage for 8s.

abilities.name: Empowering Pylon
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: warps in a pylon whose field makes Aetheri stronger (+25% damage, less damage taken).

aetheri_engineer.look: Robed Aetheri engineer in layered white cloth over gold alloy, a halo of floating tools and crystal shards, glowing blue-violet hands shaping light, a backpack frame holding folded turret parts.

abilities.name: Photon Bolt
abilities.description: Interruptible cast. A bolt of photon energy.

abilities.name: Deploy Turret
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: warps in a photon turret beside itself that fires at champions (up to 2).

abilities.name: Skitter Swarm
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: three skitter bombs scuttle at the nearest champions and explode.

abilities.name: Stasis Mine
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: plants a mine under its target that roots the first champion to step on it.

abilities.name: Field Repair
abilities.description: Interruptible 2s cast that restores 20% health to the most injured ally below 60%.

aetheri_lancer.look: Lean Aetheri marksman in gold-trimmed white alloy, a long photon lance-rifle with a crystal focusing lens, a visor of blue light, energy cables running along the arms.

abilities.name: Photon Round
abilities.description: Short aim, then fires a photon round in a fixed direction.

abilities.name: Photon Beam
abilities.description: Charges the lance, then fires a long narrow beam.

abilities.name: Orbital Strike
abilities.description: Marks a circle on its target; a column of light strikes it.

abilities.name: Recall
abilities.description: Recalls a short way back when a champion reaches melee range.

skitter_drone.look: Dog-sized mechanical skitter: a rounded gold alloy carapace, six thin spider legs, a single blue-violet eye lens and a pulsing unstable energy core on its back (fallback: small hunched two-legged construct).

abilities.name: Spark Bite
abilities.description: A crackling bite at its current target.

abilities.name: Core Burst
abilities.description: Marks a ring and vents its core, burning everyone around it.

abilities.name: Unstable Core
abilities.description: At 50% health its core destabilises: +30% damage and faster attacks.

aetheri_hierarch.look: Towering floating Aetheri hierarch in ceremonial white-gold alloy robes, a crown of orbiting crystal shards, four slender arms of light holding a warp-staff crowned with a spinning ring, a face that is a smooth mask of light.

abilities.name: Warp Lance
abilities.description: Interruptible cast. A lance of warp energy in a fixed direction.

abilities.name: Warp Pylons
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: warps in an Empowering Pylon beside itself (+25% damage for Aetheri inside).

abilities.name: Gravity Field
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: warps a gravity pylon onto its target; champions inside are slowed.

abilities.name: Warp In
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: three Skitter Drones warp in beside it.

abilities.name: Psionic Storm
abilities.description: Marks a large ring; everyone inside is silenced for 3s.

abilities.name: Final Protocol
abilities.description: At 30% health: +40% damage and faster casting until destroyed.

aetheri_colossus.look: Colossal three-legged Aetheri war engine of gold and white alloy, a crystal reactor dome for a head with a sweeping violet beam emitter, turret pods on its shoulders, energy cables and glowing seams across its hull.

abilities.name: Hull Crush
abilities.description: A crushing leg stomp at its current target.

abilities.name: Thermal Lance
abilities.description: Winds up a long cone of searing light. Get out of the cone.

abilities.name: Shoulder Turrets
abilities.description: Interruptible cast: drops a photon turret beside itself (up to 2).

abilities.name: Seismic Stomp
abilities.description: Marks a ring and stomps, knocking everyone inside back.

abilities.name: Tractor Beam
abilities.description: A beam marks a line to the farthest champion and drags them in.

abilities.name: Meltdown
abilities.description: At 30% health: +40% damage and faster attacks until destroyed.
